name: @vn-skills/mcp

tools.name: vietqr_build
tools.description: Create a VietQR (NAPAS 247) bank-transfer QR payload. Returns the EMVCo string, CRC and optionally a PNG image. Bank accepts BIN (970436), code (VCB) or name (Vietcombank). Amount is integer VND; note is sanitized (no diacritics, max 25 chars).

bank.description: Bank BIN, code or name, e.g. "VCB", "970436", "Vietcombank"

amount.description: Amount in VND (integer). Omit for a static QR.

additionalData.description: Extra tag 62 sub-fields keyed by two-digit ID, e.g. {"05":"ORDER123"}. Passed through, not interpreted. Use note for 08.

image.description: Also return a PNG image (base64). Default false.

template.description: Also return a printable SVG card (QR + bank, account, amount) as `card`.

accountName.description: Account holder shown on the card (display only, not in the payload).

tools.name: vietqr_parse
tools.description: Decode a VietQR / EMVCo QR payload string: bank, account, amount, note, and whether the CRC is valid.

payload.description: The decoded QR text, starting with 000201

tools.name: vietqr_decode
tools.description: Read the QR code in a PNG image and decode it like vietqr_parse: bank, account, amount, note, CRC validity. Give exactly one of `path` (a file on the server) or `data` (base64 of the PNG, or a data:image/png;base64, URL; max 5 MB decoded, at most 20 megapixels). Returns INVALID_INPUT unless exactly one is given, TOO_LARGE over either cap, READ_ERROR for bad base64 or an unreadable/non-PNG image and NO_QR when no QR code is found.

path.description: Path to a PNG image on the server

data.description: Base64 PNG bytes, or a data:image/png;base64,... URL (max 5 MB decoded)

tools.name: vietqr_banks
tools.description: Search the NAPAS bank list by BIN, code, short name, full name or SWIFT/BIC code. Empty query lists all banks.

tools.name: vn_address_parse
tools.description: Parse a free-text Vietnamese address into province / ward / street using the post-01/07/2025 catalogue (34 provinces, no districts). Handles missing diacritics and abbreviations (TP.HCM, Q.1, P. Bến Nghé). Set mode "legacy" for pre-2025 addresses with districts.

tools.name: vn_address_convert_batch
tools.description: Convert up to 1000 pre-July-2025 Vietnamese free-text addresses (63 provinces, districts, wards) into the new 2-level structure (34 provinces, wards) in one call. Returns per-row results plus a summary of converted and failed rows. Null, empty or non-string entries do not fail the call: they come back as failed rows (ok:false with an error code) and are counted in summary.failed.

addresses.description: Free-text old addresses (max 1000); null or empty entries become failed rows

tools.name: vn_address_convert
tools.description: Convert a pre-July-2025 Vietnamese address (63 provinces, districts, wards) into the new 2-level structure (34 provinces, wards). Returns the new ward/province, mapping type (unchanged/merged/divided) and all candidates when the old ward was split. When the client supports elicitation, the server may ask the user to pick the new ward for a split old ward (chosenBy: user|default).

tools.name: vn_address_search_wards
tools.description: Find current (post-2025) wards by name, optionally within a province.

tools.name: vn_tax_id_validate_batch
tools.description: Check up to 1000 Vietnamese tax IDs (mã số thuế) in one call. Returns per-row results (same fields as the single-value tool) plus a summary of total, valid and invalid rows. Null, empty or non-string entries do not fail the call: they come back as failed rows (ok:false, error code EMPTY) and are counted in summary.invalid.

taxIds.description: Tax IDs (max 1000); null or empty entries become failed rows

tools.name: vn_tax_id_validate
tools.description: Offline validation of a Vietnamese tax ID (mã số thuế): 10 digits (enterprise), 13 digits (branch, e.g. 0100233488-001) with check-digit verification, or 12-digit personal ID (format only). Does not query the tax authority.

tools.name: vn_id_parse_batch
tools.description: Check up to 1000 Vietnamese CCCD/CMND numbers in one call. Returns per-row results (same fields as the single-value tool) plus a summary of total, valid and invalid rows. Null, empty or non-string entries do not fail the call: they come back as failed rows (ok:false, error code EMPTY) and are counted in summary.invalid.

ids.description: Citizen ID numbers (max 1000); null or empty entries become failed rows

tools.name: vn_id_parse
tools.description: Offline validation and decoding of a 12-digit CCCD (province, sex, birth year; legacy province mapped to 2025 province) or format check of a 9-digit CMND. Format validity does not prove the identity exists.

tools.name: vn_phone_parse_batch
tools.description: Check up to 1000 Vietnamese phone numbers in one call. Returns per-row results (same fields as the single-value tool) plus a summary of total, valid and invalid rows. Null, empty or non-string entries do not fail the call: they come back as failed rows (ok:false, error code EMPTY) and are counted in summary.invalid.

phones.description: Phone numbers (max 1000); null or empty entries become failed rows

tools.name: vn_phone
tools.description: Normalise a Vietnamese phone number (0/84/+84, old 11-digit 01xx mobile prefixes) to national and E.164 forms and classify it: mobile (original carrier) or landline (area code, province). Offline.

tools.name: vn_name
tools.description: Split a Vietnamese full name into họ / tên đệm / tên (handles Tôn Thất, Nguyễn Phúc), plus slug and initials; or sort a list of names by tên with Vietnamese collation (sortAs: "text" sorts any strings).

sortAs.description: "name" (default) sorts by tên; "text" sorts whole strings

tools.name: vn_money_to_words
tools.description: Read an integer VND amount in Vietnamese words, e.g. 1200000 -> "một triệu hai trăm nghìn đồng". Also reads plain numbers without a unit with plain: true, e.g. 30 -> "ba mươi". Reads ordinals with ordinal: true, e.g. 4 -> "thứ tư" (second "nhì"/"hai" for 2). Options: thousand "nghìn"/"ngàn", odd "lẻ"/"linh", capitalize, unit, lang "en" for English words (e.g. "one million two hundred thousand dong").

plain.description: Read a plain number without a unit (default false); not with unit/chan

ordinal.description: Read an ordinal ("thứ nhất", "thứ tư"); integers >= 1, implies plain

tools.name: vn_text_speech_normalize
tools.description: Rewrite numbers, VND amounts (1.250.000đ, 500k), percentages, phone numbers and dd/mm/yyyy dates in text as spoken Vietnamese for text-to-speech. Decimals and partial dates are left unchanged and listed in skipped. Returns text, changes, skipped.

tools.name: vn_money_parse
tools.description: Parse an amount written in Vietnamese words back to digits, e.g. "một triệu hai trăm nghìn đồng" -> "1200000". Returns value (digit string), negative, unit, chan.

tools.name: vn_number_format
tools.description: Format numbers/VND/dates the Vietnamese way (1.234.567,89; 1.200.000 ₫; 1,2 triệu; dd/MM/yyyy) or parse typed amounts ("1tr2", "500k", "1,5 tỷ"; "1.500" = 1500).

style.description: Date style, only for mode "date" (default numeric dd/MM/yyyy)

tools.name: vn_lunar_from_solar
tools.description: Convert a Gregorian date (dd/mm/yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd) to the Vietnamese lunar date with can chi (e.g. Ất Tỵ), zodiac, leap-month flag and solar term. Optional hour (0-23) adds hourCanChi, hourBranch, hourRange (giờ sinh).

tools.name: vn_lunar_to_solar
tools.description: Convert a Vietnamese lunar date to the Gregorian date. Set leap=true for the leap (nhuận) month.

tools.name: vn_lunar_parse_date
tools.description: Turn a Vietnamese date phrase into a solar date: lunar ("rằm tháng Giêng năm sau", "mùng 1 Tết", "23 tháng Chạp"), relative ("ngày mai", "3 ngày nữa", "thứ Sáu tuần sau") or Gregorian. ref (yyyy-mm-dd) defaults to today in UTC+7.

tools.name: vn_lunar_month
tools.description: Calendar of a Gregorian month: each day with lunar date (leap flag, mùng 1, rằm), day can chi, solar term starts and holidays/days off.

tools.name: vn_lunar_holidays
tools.description: List Vietnamese holidays for a solar year (Tết, Giỗ Tổ Hùng Vương, 30/4, 1/5, 2/9, Trung thu...). Lunar holidays are resolved to solar dates. publicOnly limits to official days off.

tools.name: vn_holidays_year
tools.description: Official days off for public-sector staff in a year (2023-2199): Tết Dương lịch, Tết Âm lịch, Giỗ Tổ Hùng Vương, 30/4, 1/5, Quốc khánh, Ngày Văn hóa Việt Nam 24/11 (from 2026), with nghỉ bù and swapped working Saturdays from the Government notice. Unannounced years return the statutory days, announced: false and the pending Tết / National Day days.

tools.name: vn_holidays_ics
tools.description: Export the official days off of a year (2023-2199) as iCalendar (RFC 5545) text for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar: holidays, nghỉ bù, swapped days and (optionally) working Saturdays. Unannounced years omit pending days and list them in warnings.

tools.name: vn_holidays_is_working_day
tools.description: Whether a date is a working day for public-sector staff (Monday-Friday minus holidays and nghỉ bù, plus swapped Saturdays). certain: false when the year is not announced and the date may still become a Tết or National Day day off.

tools.name: vn_holidays_add_working_days
tools.description: The date n working days after (or before, n < 0) a date, skipping weekends, holidays and nghỉ bù; the start date is not counted. certain: false if unannounced days were crossed.

tools.name: vn_holidays_count_working_days
tools.description: Number of working days in (from, to]: the start date is not counted, the end date is; negative if to is before from. Skips weekends, holidays and nghỉ bù. certain: false if unannounced Tết or National Day days were crossed.

tools.name: vn_einvoice_validate
tools.description: Validate an e-invoice (hóa đơn điện tử) object against the mandatory contents of Decree 123/2020 (series, date, seller tax ID, lines, VAT rates 0/5/8/10/KCT/KKKNT).

invoice.description: Invoice object: {series, issueDate, seller{name,taxId,address}, buyer{...}, lines[{name,quantity,unitPrice,vatRate}]}

tools.name: vn_einvoice_totals
tools.description: Validate an invoice and compute line amounts, VAT per rate, grand total and the total in Vietnamese words.

invoice.description: Invoice object: {series, issueDate, seller{name,taxId,address}, buyer{...}, lines[{name,quantity,unitPrice,vatRate}]}

tools.name: vn_einvoice_vat
tools.description: Apply VAT to a net amount, or with inclusive=true split a VAT-inclusive price (giá đã gồm VAT) into net (tiền hàng) and VAT. Rates 0/5/8/10/KCT/KKKNT. Net is rounded half away from zero and the leftover đồng goes to VAT (library convention).

tools.name: vn_einvoice_mock_issue
tools.description: Issue an invoice through the in-memory MOCK provider (no real API, nothing persisted). Useful for testing integrations before wiring MISA/Viettel/VNPT sandbox adapters.

invoice.description: Invoice object: {series, issueDate, seller{name,taxId,address}, buyer{...}, lines[{name,quantity,unitPrice,vatRate}]}

tools.name: vn_lunar_tet
tools.description: Solar date of Tết (lunar new year) for a year, with can chi and leap month.

tools.name: vn_lunar_canchi
tools.description: Can chi (e.g. Giáp Thìn) of a lunar year, with its leap month if any.

tools.name: vn_tax_id_check_digit
tools.description: Compute the 10th check digit of a Vietnamese tax ID from its first 9 digits.

tools.name: vn_address_provinces
tools.description: List the 34 current Vietnamese provinces (since 01/07/2025) with ward counts.

tools.name: vn_address_history
tools.description: List the pre-01/07/2025 wards (with district and province) that became a current ward, by ward code or name.

tools.name: vn_address_province
tools.description: Look up one current province by name, alias (e.g. "TP.HCM") or 2-digit code.

tools.name: vn_einvoice_example
tools.description: Return a valid example invoice object to start from.

instructions:
vn-skills: offline Vietnamese data tools. It builds and validates data only. It does not collect payments, confirm transfers or call bank, NAPAS or government systems.

Rules
- Amounts are integer VND, no decimals. Turn "500k", "1tr2", "1,5 tỷ" into an integer with vn_number_format (parse) before vietqr_build.
- Addresses use the 34-province, 2-level layout (province + ward) effective 01/07/2025. Use vn_address_convert for old 63-province/district addresses.
- A valid CCCD, tax ID (MST) or phone format does not prove the person, company or line exists. Never send IDs to third parties.

Which tool
- VietQR / "tạo mã QR chuyển khoản": vietqr_build, vietqr_parse, vietqr_banks
- Address / "đổi địa chỉ mới": vn_address_convert, vn_address_parse
- Tax ID / "kiểm tra mã số thuế": vn_tax_id_validate
- CCCD / "đọc căn cước": vn_id_parse
- Phone / "số điện thoại": vn_phone
- Holidays / "ngày nghỉ lễ", "ngày làm việc": vn_holidays_year, vn_holidays_is_working_day
- Money in words / "số tiền bằng chữ": vn_money_to_words
- Lunar / "âm lịch", "dương lịch": vn_lunar_from_solar, vn_lunar_to_solar
- E-invoice / "hóa đơn điện tử": vn_einvoice_validate, vn_einvoice_totals
- Names / "tên người Việt": vn_name
- Number formatting / "định dạng số tiền": vn_number_format
